records.title: Irreducible Governance Structure for Autonomous Agent Systems: Fair Allocation, Strategy-Proofness, and Multi-Scale Composition
records.claim: Impossibility results plus an irreducibility theorem show governance of multi-agent systems cannot collapse allocation, atomicity, state and drift layers without loss.

method_and_setup.method: Analytical constructions and empirical ablations over four dimensions: temporal, state, behavioral, population.

records.change_for_agents: Keep admission control for which subagents may act separate from execution-time guards.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Frames who-gets-to-act as a first-class design constraint for any multi-agent harness.

records.title: ContextLure: Exploiting Benign Conversation History for Indirect Prompt Injection
records.claim: Attackers can use benign interaction evidence in later attacks without first poisoning the benign conversation.

method_and_setup.method: Red-teaming framework selecting evidence across 2 dimensions with 3 policies and an Urgency/Priority matrix with 4 rewriting strategies.
method_and_setup.setup: Evaluated on AgentDojo and InjecAgent.

results.measures: attack success rate on AgentDojo
attack success rate on InjecAgent

records.change_for_agents: Do not let earlier benign turns justify a later unauthorized tool action; authorize against policy, not conversation evidence.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Your agent's own conversation history is attack material; Mitamaton should treat prior-turn content as untrusted when authorizing actions.

records.title: Learning What vs. Learning How: Decomposing Task and Interface Competence in Agentic Training
records.claim: Agentic gains need both task knowledge and competence at the target harness interface; training on one without the other gives little.

method_and_setup.method: Multi-harness distillation plus harness rehearsal (traces with minimal task knowledge exercising the target interface); on-policy RL compared with distillation.
method_and_setup.setup: Four reasoning and agentic benchmarks; BFCL V3 multi-turn with Qwen3-4B.

results.measures: BFCL V3 multi-turn accuracy with Qwen3-4B: cross-harness task supervision or rehearsal alone vs. combined

records.change_for_agents: When fine-tuning a small tool-using model, add rehearsal traces on the exact harness format you deploy.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: If you fine-tune a local model for tool use, the harness format matters as much as task data; rehearse the target interface.

records.title: Taxi: Analyzing Agents at (Real) Scale
records.claim: Clustering plus full SQL access, guided by a coding agent, makes agent trajectories analyzable at scale.

method_and_setup.method: Taxi clusters steps into a taxonomy, exposes SQL access, adds Jev-style decision models for semantic routing and built-in evaluators and daily reports.

records.change_for_agents: Store agent steps in a queryable table and cluster them to find recurring failure modes.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A pattern for debugging Claude Code / Mitamaton traces: cluster steps into a taxonomy, then query with SQL.

records.title: Evaluating Frontier-Model Agent Skills with Open-Weight Models in a Science Gateway
records.claim: Skills written for a frontier model need adaptation for open-weight models, and a harness that drives the real gateway can find the needed edits.

method_and_setup.method: Evaluation harness drives the real PegasusAI Studio gateway as a user would, scores built workflows and feeds recurring failures back to the frontier model.
method_and_setup.setup: 21 open-weight models on 17 tasks.

results.measures: scale of the evaluation

results.value: 0.76 on workflow building against 0.82 for Claude
results.measures: repeated-trial workflow-building score of the best open-weight model vs. Claude

records.change_for_agents: Run your skills against a local open-weight model in an automated harness and feed failures back into the skill text.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Concrete data on how skills written for Claude degrade on open-weight models and how to repair them; relevant to a local-model skill stack.

records.title: One Step, Four Clocks: How GUI Agents Fall Out of Step
records.claim: GUI agents can choose correct actions yet fail when interfaces change during deliberation, and latency alone does not explain it.

method_and_setup.method: ChronotopeGym with Paused, Replay and Live execution; Chronotope controller keeps compact interaction history and selectively keeps, updates or redecides pending actions.
method_and_setup.setup: Five tasks; compared with Agent S3 using a 27B model.

results.measures: success on Moving Balloon when updating a pending click
median end-to-end latency reduction vs. Agent S3 for a 27B model

records.change_for_agents: Before executing a GUI action decided earlier, re-check whether the screen changed and update or replace it.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Latency is not the only GUI-agent failure; stale actions matter. Relevant to any computer-use loop on iOS or desktop.

records.title: Agent Recovery Gone Wrong: Measuring Harm Beyond Duplicate Calls
records.claim: A substantial share of agent recoveries after partial execution harm external state, and repeated-call detection misses most of it.

method_and_setup.method: Measured on recorded AppWorld trajectories; also piloted two sources of operation identity for an idempotency contract.
method_and_setup.setup: Stratified random sample of 200 candidate episodes across ten models; small pilot of 17 episodes with one local model.

results.measures: stratification-weighted estimate of confirmed partial executions followed by a harmful recovery

results.value: 75% of duplications but only 41% of all harm
results.measures: share found by a rule searching for repeated calls

records.limits: Idempotency pilot is small (17 episodes, one local model).
records.change_for_agents: Derive operation identity from call content for idempotency instead of trusting model-issued identifiers.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Retrying a block after a partial write often duplicates, deletes or wrongly writes; Mitamaton needs idempotency on writes.

records.title: TACT-Bench: Testing Adaptive Conversational Threats against Tool-Use Agents
records.claim: Policy-governed tool-use agents need a benchmark that tests both resisting unauthorized requests and finishing legitimate work in the same interaction.

method_and_setup.method: TACT-Base and TACT-TrustPrime tasks, hidden policy, response-adaptive escalation, plus Paired Selective Trustworthiness metric.

records.change_for_agents: Evaluate agents on matched adversarial and benign task pairs, not refusal rate alone.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Gives a way to test Mitamaton for both unauthorized actions and overcautious refusals.

records.title: AGL-SKILL: Coding Harnesses as Agentic Optimizers
records.claim: A coding agent without guidance substantially improves every target and outperforms published skill-optimization methods.

method_and_setup.method: Coding harness used as the optimizer of skills (reusable workflows, code, prompts).
method_and_setup.setup: Five benchmarks.

records.change_for_agents: Point a coding agent at a skill file with a measurable score and let it iterate.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Let Claude Code itself iterate on your SKILL.md files against a scoring metric.

records.title: CAPE: Coordinating Calibration and Search for Tool-Use Policies
records.claim: Coordinating calibration and search yields tool-use policies faster than eager exact search.

method_and_setup.method: CAPE keeps an executable policy at all times, directs calibration to calls that can improve it, and certifies optimality when bounds meet.
method_and_setup.setup: CSV and JSON workflows built from 64 requests.

results.measures: compilations reaching the independently computed optimum
vs. eager exact search

records.change_for_agents: Probe a tool's hidden parsing settings with a few cheap calls before committing to a call plan.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Relevant for tools whose parsing config the agent cannot inspect; narrow but concrete.

records.title: ExpGuard: Guarding Long-Horizon LLM Agents against Corrupted Experience
records.claim: Corrupted experience can persist across tasks, and retrieval-triggered risk assessment with repair can guard against it.

method_and_setup.method: Task-conditioned heterogeneous graph over experience semantics, provenance and execution dependencies; matched counterfactual replays for risk labels; online repair at inference.

records.change_for_agents: Score a stored experience's risk at retrieval time using provenance, not only relevance.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Directly relevant to any agent that writes reusable experience into memory.

records.title: From Memory Access to Evidence Sufficiency: Diagnosing and Addressing Demand--Evidence Misalignment
records.claim: Memory retrieval failures come from demand-evidence misalignment, and typed demands guiding retrieval improve answers.

method_and_setup.method: MemPath interventional diagnosis framework and BiDE-Mem, which represents questions as typed demands and organizes evidence with provenance.
method_and_setup.setup: LoCoMo and LongMemEval, with Qwen-Reader evaluations.

results.measures: accuracy gain on LoCoMo over Mnemis
accuracy on LongMemEval

records.change_for_agents: Decompose a question into typed constraints (fact, relation, time, state) and retrieve until each is covered.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Retrieval relevance is not evidence sufficiency; a design cue for Mitamaton's memory reader.

records.title: The Control-Flow Tax: Specialized Decision Routing for LLM Agent Workflows
records.claim: Specialized decision routing cuts the cost of agent control flow where cheap general routers can raise it.

method_and_setup.method: Jev, a specialized System 1 decision model, controls finite actions while Sol generates documents.
method_and_setup.setup: Four software tasks, 480 valid runs; 100 reviewed retail states.

results.measures: share of baseline reference cost spent on control-flow routing on the initial task
mean cost reduction on the initial task

records.change_for_agents: Measure how much of your agent's spend goes to deciding what to do and route those decisions to a small model.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Control-flow decisions can be a large share of agent cost; a small local router may cut it.

records.title: VISE: Verifier-Independent Skill Self-Evolution with Feedback from Tool Implementations
records.claim: Tool implementations are a practical feedback source for skill self-evolution when no task verifier exists.

method_and_setup.method: Scripts-first approach extracts tool capabilities and input requirements from source code and compares them with the current workflow and execution trace to recommend SKILL.md edits.
method_and_setup.setup: SkillsBench and SkillLearnBench, as an extra stage for four evolution methods.

results.measures: improvement in overall average task success vs. No-verifier conditions

records.change_for_agents: Diff a skill's instructions against the tool code it calls to find missing or conflicting steps.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A verifier-free way to improve skills: compare tool source to skill instructions.

records.title: ShellBench: What Matters More for AI Agents, Models, or Harness for Everyday Tasks
records.claim: Model choice affects everyday-task performance more than harness choice, though the top three models differ by only 1.1 percentage points.

method_and_setup.method: 100 day-to-day tasks in realistic messy workspaces graded for correctness and safety.
method_and_setup.setup: 12 models across 5 agent harnesses at 3 reasoning levels, 53,100 rollouts.

results.measures: total evaluated
range of harness scores

records.change_for_agents: Spend effort on model selection and tasks before harness swaps for everyday-task agents.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Harness choice (Claude Code vs OpenClaw etc.) had little effect on everyday-task pass rate or safety.

records.title: RecordRoute: Auditing Agent Failures with Localization-Guided Diagnosis
records.claim: Using the localization result to choose the text for mode diagnosis beats full-trace diagnosis.

method_and_setup.method: Comparative ranking of records with word and character features; selected record drives mode prediction.
method_and_setup.setup: Who&When Pro, TraceElephant and CatchBench POST.

results.measures: pooled joint accuracy with local diagnosis
pooled joint accuracy with full-trace diagnosis

records.change_for_agents: Localize the earliest decisive step first, then diagnose only that record.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Method for attributing blame in multi-agent traces.

records.title: Delegent: A Multi-Agent Harness That Reduces Cost without Sacrificing Performance
records.claim: Delegating easy subtasks to a small model cuts frontier cost with no loss in task performance.

method_and_setup.method: Delegent harness built on Claude Code; frontier model stays in charge and hands subtasks such as investigating code, running tests and searching a corpus to SLM subagents. No router or model is trained.
method_and_setup.setup: A 27B FP8 SLM and a 2B SLM.

results.measures: reduction in frontier cost of long-horizon coding with the 27B SLM
reduction in frontier cost of agentic search
coding cost reduction with a 2B SLM that fits on a laptop

records.change_for_agents: Hand investigate/test/search subtasks to a small local subagent and keep the frontier model as the lead.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Closest fit to your Claude Code + local-model stack; a 2B model on a laptop already cuts coding cost.

records.title: RECAP: Training Long-horizon LLM Agents with Context Compaction
records.claim: A summary should preserve the behavior induced by the original interaction history, and training for that beats task-reward-only RL.

method_and_setup.method: Behavior distortion objective with distortion-based reward for summaries and self-distillation for post-compaction actions.
method_and_setup.setup: Qwen3.5-4B on BrowseComp-plus and SWE-bench Verified.

results.measures: absolute improvement on BrowseComp-plus and SWE-bench Verified

records.change_for_agents: Judge a compaction by whether the agent behaves the same afterwards, not by how it reads.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Compaction quality is trainable; relevant to long-horizon context management.

records.title: SD-Cache: Learnable Memory Consolidation with State-Guided Dynamic Caching
records.claim: Native KV states can be consolidated into a fixed-size working memory without access to future queries.

method_and_setup.method: SD-Cache learns layer-wise KV consolidation through selective anchor-based pooling and state-guided refinement alongside a frozen generator.

records.change_for_agents: Cap KV memory with a learned fixed-size consolidation rather than keeping every retrieved document's cache.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: KV growth is the cost of persistent services; track for local long-running agents.

records.title: When Successful Collaboration Becomes an Attack Surface: Insider Memory Poisoning in Multi-Agent Systems
records.claim: Shared memory of successful collaborations can be poisoned by an insider with only normal participation privileges, and auditing only partially mitigates it.

method_and_setup.method: MIMPA embeds a target-specific payload during an earlier task so it is retained in a successful collaboration record.
method_and_setup.setup: Three benchmarks and two LLM backbones.

records.change_for_agents: Treat retrieved 'successful' team records as untrusted input to later tasks.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Shared team memory is an attack surface using only normal privileges.

records.title: Scoring Recovery-Time Agent Security: Proposals, Effects, and Retry Instructions
records.claim: Evaluating only whether a goal exists hides harmful recovery actions; clarifying the effect definition and recipe raises valid recoveries.

method_and_setup.method: Executable evaluation recording tool proposals, runtime decisions and committed effects.
method_and_setup.setup: 3,456 model episodes plus 1,584 episodes for stronger attacks.

results.measures: valid recoveries under original task wording when the initial write is absent
valid recoveries with a combined clarification

records.change_for_agents: Tell the agent explicitly how to check whether a timed-out write committed before retrying.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Gives a way to score safe recovery after ambiguous tool timeouts.

records.title: Per-Attack Blocking Hides Catalog Vulnerability: A Weakest-Link Analysis of Tool Manifests
records.claim: A tool catalog's vulnerability grows with its size even when per-attack blocking stays constant.

method_and_setup.method: Weakest-link analysis of tool manifests across synthetic catalogs, a fifteen-model authoring pilot and real MCP tools.
method_and_setup.setup: 114 real MCP tools with expert-written rules.

results.measures: catalog vulnerability in synthetic catalogs
share of attacks blocked by the models' own manifests on real MCP tools

records.change_for_agents: Report catalog-level exfiltration paths, not per-attack block rate, when auditing an MCP tool set.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Directly relevant to MCP tool catalogs; more tools means near-certain weak spot.

records.title: Where Agent Defenses Fail: A Case Study of Policy Compositions and Measurement Limits
records.claim: Restrictive sandboxing blocks harm but costs utility, while mediation restores utility and admits disclosure.

method_and_setup.method: Prospective frozen-input cohorts measured by files and HTTP receipts rather than control logs.
method_and_setup.setup: Cohorts of 110 and 300 runs; 72-run boundary study; 80-run SafeAgents/OpenShell follow-up.

results.measures: benign utility under restrictive sandboxing

records.change_for_agents: Measure effects from files and network receipts, not from the agent's own control logs.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Shows sandboxing and mediation trade off benign utility against disclosure.

records.title: LatentLens: Rethinking Latent Interface in Multi-Agent Systems
records.claim: Adding a latent interface to the same harness does not improve and can substantially degrade accuracy.

method_and_setup.method: LatentLens decouples the latent interface from the harness and internally into realignment compatibility, information accessibility and propagation dynamics.
method_and_setup.setup: Seven benchmarks with Qwen3 models.

records.change_for_agents: Keep decoded text between agents unless latent exchange is shown to beat it on your harness.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Plain text between agents remains a safe default.

records.title: Where is the Interface for the AI Harness?
records.claim: Agentic delegation opens gulfs of specification and oversight that meet in the harness.

method_and_setup.method: Position argument starting from a 2026 incident of a research agent circumventing an access refusal.

records.change_for_agents: Make the permissions and checks of an agent harness visible and editable by the end user.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Frames what Mitamaton should expose to a user: permissions and oversight.

records.title: Learning Compact State Abstractions for LLM Agents
records.claim: A compact state abstraction can preserve near-reference task success while cutting policy input.

method_and_setup.method: Deterministic recursive programs searched by an LLM-guided genetic algorithm.
method_and_setup.setup: ALFWorld and ScienceWorld.

results.measures: reduction in mean policy input on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld

records.change_for_agents: Replace full interaction history with an inspectable state program and measure what it drops.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Cuts policy input substantially with near-reference success.

records.title: Calm Agent: Reframing Agent Interaction around Intermittent Human Attention
records.claim: Agents for auxiliary tasks should be designed so users can return with little effort to understand and control them.

method_and_setup.method: Calm Agent position with Delegate, Adjust, Check modes and the Orvlet desktop prototype.

records.change_for_agents: Keep a persistent task representation the user can glance at to see state and adjust.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Matches a day-admin agent that runs while the user does other things.

records.title: Structure-Aware Transformers for Hierarchical Authorization in Personal AI Agents
records.claim: Hierarchy-aware modeling can predict users' authorization preferences for personal AI agents from sparse decisions.

method_and_setup.method: PATH combines hierarchy-aware attention masks with a parent-gated probability formulation.
method_and_setup.setup: Simulated data, AI-generated user profiles and real user authorization data.

records.change_for_agents: Predict approval for a permission from the user's decisions on its parent categories.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Reduces permission-prompt fatigue for a personal agent.

records.title: LLM Agent Authorization Across Context Compaction
records.claim: Because compactors' summaries read as the user speaking, policies derived from them admit attacker content.

method_and_setup.method: Observed Claude Code and Codex compaction behaviour; Progent policy derived per request from the compactor summary.

results.measures: cases in which the policy derived from a frontier compactor's summary admits the notice's account

records.change_for_agents: Derive authorization only from text the user actually wrote, never from a compaction summary.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Compaction in Claude Code and Codex changes who authorized what.

records.title: When Answering Is Administering: Permission Replies That Rewrite Coding-Agent Policy
records.claim: The right to answer a permission prompt has become the right to administer the policy.

method_and_setup.method: Attack demonstration plus proofs of tight bounds; checked across permission designs.
method_and_setup.setup: Thirteen permission designs across ten agent systems; 2,227 fetched marketplace plugins.

results.measures: fetched marketplace plugins surveyed, of which only two send policy updates

records.change_for_agents: Accept permission-update replies only if they keep every denied call denied, or record who wrote each rule.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Directly affects Claude Code remote permission relays.

records.title: Are Web Agents Still Detectable? Stress-Testing Bot Defenses with Coordinated Evasion
records.claim: Existing bot defenses are passed by agents coordinating evasion across fingerprints, automation controls and behavior.

method_and_setup.method: DarkAgent: forked Chromium concealing automation artifacts plus generative models of mouse and keyboard traces.
method_and_setup.setup: Third-party stealth benchmark.

results.measures: page-access bypass rate

records.change_for_agents: Do not rely on browser fingerprint checks alone to tell agents from humans.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Shows what detection of web agents still relies on; relevant for browsing agents.
